items.excerpt: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.

items.excerpt: The OpenAI science blog shares new findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.

items.excerpt: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

items.excerpt: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

items.excerpt: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.

items.excerpt: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

items.headline: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
items.excerpt: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

items.headline: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers

items.headline: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
items.excerpt: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.

items.headline: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
items.excerpt: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

items.headline: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
items.excerpt: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

items.excerpt: Discover how Singapore Airlines uses OpenAI models and API to enhance customer support, travel discovery, and employee productivity, doubling CSAT for its Kris chatbot.

items.headline: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
items.excerpt: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.
